pick.name: ElevenLabs
pick.what: Leading hosted TTS, voice cloning, dubbing
pick.why: Most natural voices and languages; Starter $6/mo (30k credits) includes a commercial licence.
pick.free_limits: Free: 10,000 credits/mo, no commercial licence, and published output must credit 'elevenlabs.io' or '11.ai' in the title. Starter $6/mo (30k credits) adds the commercial licence; Creator $22/mo (121k); Pro $99 (600k); Scale $299; Business $990. Paid commercial licence excludes Beta Services

best_free.name: Kokoro-82M
best_free.why: Apache-2.0, runs on CPU, 9 language codes incl. Hindi, no watermark.
best_free.install: pip install kokoro>=0.9.4 soundfile (plus espeak-ng system package for out-of-vocabulary English and some languages)
best_free.license: Apache-2.0 (code and weights); espeak-ng is a separate GPL-3.0 program invoked at runtime

candidates.name: Gemini API TTS free tier
candidates.verdict: free-tier data used to improve Google products; commercial terms unclear

decision: ElevenLabs is the best-sounding option and paid Starter includes commercial rights. Kokoro is the free, local, Apache-licensed alternative with lower expressiveness.
details: Candidates list is stale from the old map ('Kokoro-82M: pick', 'ElevenLabs: alt paid'): update to ElevenLabs pick, Kokoro best_free.

verify.note: 'No attribution mentioned' was wrong: the help centre requires attribution on the free plan and bars commercial use. The pick holds as best overall.
